name: apply_ppt_standards
title: PowerPoint Standards
description: Agent workflow contract for creating, revising, or reviewing PowerPoint decks; requires a separate authoring and rendering environment

request.description: Creation brief, edits, or review objective, including explicit output and scope preferences

mode.description: Choose the operation before any edit or export: create/revise may change the authorized deck; review inspects existing artifacts and reports findings without saving over, repairing, or regenerating deliverables. Temporary inspection previews belong in scratch storage.

deck_path.description: Existing editable deck; required for revise and review

output_path.description: Requested PPTX destination for create or revise; resolve from context if omitted. Not used in review mode.

source_paths.description: Read-only source material supporting the slides

audience.description: Audience context if not already in the brief

slide_scope.description: Stable slide identifiers, current titles, or page references; interpret against the latest deck

interaction.description: Use the requested collaboration pace; do not ask again for an already authorized edit

sync_pdf.description: For create/revise: true requests PDF delivery; false disables it. If omitted, infer from the requested formats or an established PPTX/PDF delivery workflow; otherwise deliver PPTX only. An existing PDF alone does not establish that workflow. Ignored in review mode, which produces findings rather than deliverable artifacts.

status.description: Completed only for the requested scope and deliverables; awaiting_review for a requested proposal checkpoint; partial for unresolved required work

pptx_path.description: Delivered editable artifact, or null for review-only/proposal-only work

pdf_path.description: Current delivered PDF, or null for review/proposal-only work, when PDF delivery does not apply, or when export failed; never a stale file.

changes.description: Completed edits; empty for review-only or proposal-only work.
